name: Passport Index

measures.definition: Read on the publisher's page; not copied.

vetted.notes: Visa-free travel, not the right to live; proprietary.

personalUse: For a person to read. Automated reading (an agent fetching the page) needs the publisher's permission; a figure the person reads there and gives their agent may be kept in that person's cache with the page's address, never committed or published.
